items.name: Bread
items.desc: A heel of dark bread. Filling.

items.name: Green gem
items.desc: A small green stone from the quarry. You never mentioned it to Garran.

items.name: Crab meat
items.desc: Sweet white meat, cracked out of the shell.

enemies.name: Yellow-eyed wolf
enemies.desc: A starved grey wolf, all ribs and matted fur. Its eyes have gone the colour of old pus, and it doesn't blink.

moves.name: snaps at you
moves.tell: It circles you, snapping at the air.

moves.name: lunges at your throat
moves.tell: It drops low and its back legs bunch. It's going to lunge.

moves.name: backs off, hackles up
moves.tell: It backs off a step, watching your hands. It's ready for you.

enemies.name: Rock crab
enemies.desc: A crab the size of a dinner plate, barnacled and old. One claw is far bigger than the other, and there's a yellow crust where its eyes should shine.

moves.name: pinches at your ankle
moves.tell: It sidles towards you, big claw open.

moves.name: clamps its big claw on you
moves.tell: It rears up and raises both claws high.

moves.name: hunkers down behind its shell
moves.tell: It pulls its legs in and hunkers behind its shell.

classes.name: Adventurer
classes.desc: Travelling, surviving and fighting. More stamina for the road.

classes.name: Blacksmith
classes.desc: Crafting, mining and defence. Stronger arms.

classes.name: Mage
classes.desc: Magic, intellect and enchanting. A sharper mind.

backgrounds.name: Desk job
backgrounds.desc: Eight hours a day of screens and spreadsheets.

backgrounds.name: Weekend runner
backgrounds.desc: The one thing you did for yourself.

backgrounds.name: Night shifts
backgrounds.desc: Long hours on your feet while everyone else slept.

backgrounds.name: Shop floor
backgrounds.desc: Smiling at people who never smiled back.

gear.name: Gutting knife
gear.desc: Yenson's spare. Made for fish, not fights, but it has a point.

gear.name: Iron knife
gear.desc: Plain and sharp, and you made it.

gear.name: Hide buckler
gear.desc: A small round shield of boiled hide on an iron rim.

gear.name: Reinforced work gloves
gear.desc: Leather with iron studs across the knuckles.

gear.name: Salt-stiff shirt
gear.desc: Your own shirt, stiff with dried seawater and torn at one sleeve.

gear.name: Torn trousers
gear.desc: Good cloth once. The sea and the rocks have had their way with them.

gear.name: Salt-stained boots
gear.desc: They squelch less than they did, which is something.

gear.name: Iron cap
gear.desc: A plain round cap of hammered iron. It won't stop much, but it'll stop something.

gear.name: Leather jerkin
gear.desc: Thick, laced leather that turns a claw or a glancing blade.

gear.name: Leather boots
gear.desc: Tall boots of oiled leather. Dry feet, steady footing.

gear.name: Bone charm
gear.desc: A carved bone on a leather cord. Fishermen here wear them against the sea.

gear.name: Copper ring
gear.desc: A plain copper band, gone green at the edges.

gear.name: Woodcutter's axe
gear.desc: A long-hafted axe made for felling trees. It takes both hands, and it hits like it.

traits.name: Balanced
traits.desc: Sits well in the hand. The timing bar's sweet spot is wider.

traits.name: Warded
traits.desc: Holds back a little of the corruption's growth on you.

traits.name: Kindled
traits.desc: Every hit carries a little fire.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.desc: Blocks a little more of every hit.

traits.name: Swift
traits.desc: Helps you act before your enemy.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.desc: More stamina to work and fight with.

materials.name: Green gem
materials.desc: Your green quarry gem is set in the {part}.

spells.name: Draw Water
spells.desc: Pull water out of the air. Refills your waterskin; puts out small fires.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.desc: A spark of fire. Lights fires, and stings in a fight.

journal.text: Follow the coast road to the village Yenson told you about.
Help the hunters at the lodge: firewood, water and food.
Help Garran the blacksmith get his forge going again.
Visit old Orlen, the retired mage.
Go to the class stone at the guild post and choose your path.
Skelmed needs more help than you can give it here. Head for the nearest town.

routes.name: The coast road
routes.night: It's dark. You can hear the sea better than you can see the road.

stops.name: Yenson's shack
stops.desc: Yenson's chimney smokes behind you. The coast road runs north along the shore, between gorse and the grey edge of the sea.
stops.leg: Packed sand and stones underfoot. The sea is still sulking after the storm, throwing weed and splintered wood up the beach.

stops.name: The tide pools
stops.desc: Black rocks run out into the sea here, pocked with pools. Weed hangs off everything.

choices.label: Search the tide pools
choices.result: You pick your way out over the weed-slick rocks. Most of the pools are empty, but you prise two handfuls of mussels off the stones before a wave soaks you to the knee.

stops.leg: The road climbs. Gorse closes in on both sides, and the wind gets up as the headland rises ahead.

stops.name: The headland
stops.desc: The road crests the headland. A sheep track leads off to the very top.

choices.label: Climb to the top for a look around

stops.leg: The road drops off the headland and winds inland through rough grazing. Nobody grazes it now.

stops.name: The stream
stops.desc: The road drops into a sheltered dip where a stream runs down to the sea. Bramble bushes crowd the banks. Up ahead, roofs and a crooked harbour light: Skelmed.

choices.label: Fill your waterskin at the stream
choices.result: The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. You drink, then fill the skin.

choices.label: Pick blackberries
choices.result: Your hands come away scratched and stained purple, with three good handfuls of blackberries.

stops.leg: The last stretch. The road widens into an old cart track, rutted by wheels that stopped coming years ago.

stops.name: Skelmed
stops.desc: The edge of the village. Grey cottages and a harbour far too big for them.
